title: Wɔkasa Kɔ Asetra mu
intro: Onipa bi fi abakɔsɛm kronkron mu ba, na okura anwonwade ahorow a ɛne abɔde mu nhyehyɛe no nhyia. Saa ɔkra yi nam ɔsoro ahyɛde biako so na ɛbae, bɔɔ ɔwofo bi ho ban fii sobo a emu yɛ den ho, na ofii wiase yi mu ansa na asase so nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn retumi akyekyere wɔn. Asɛm no fi akokoaa a ɛba fam so kosi ɔsoro a ɛwɔ soro no so. Hena na obetumi ayɛ eyi?
clues: Wosomaa me se Nsenkyerennee ne mmoborohunu a efiri Allah ho maa Israelmma.
Na me mmaeɛ no nte sɛ kan biara — menam ɔsoro asɛmfua ‘Yɛ!’ so na ɛbaeɛ. a onni asase so agya.
M’awofo hyiaa atirimɔdensɛm abususɛm, nanso adiyi kronkron sii fam sɛ ɛbɛka sɛ wɔn ho nni asɛm na wɔama wɔn gyinabea so.
Sɛ́ akokoaa a wɔawo no foforo no, memaa wɔn a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no ho dwiriw wɔn denam kasa a mekasae pefee fii me mpa so de tew m’awofo din mu no so.
Ɛnam Allah kwan so no, mede dɔteɛ a nkwa nnim na ɛhyehyɛɛ nkwa, maa anifuraefoɔ hunu adeɛ, na mede me nsa kaa ɔkwatani no yareɛ.
Wɔmaa me kɔɔ soro ansa na ɔhaw retumi aka me, na mɛsan aba wiase yi mu ansa na Dɔnhwerew a etwa to no adu.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Ɔkasa a efi akokoaa no so bere a na ɔyɛ akokoaa
Ɔtra ase wɔ apataa kɛse bi yafunu mu
Wɔtow no gu ogya a ɛredɛw mu
Adaka kɛse a wɔresi ansa na nsuyiri aba
trial.answer: Ɔkasa a efi akokoaa no so bere a na ɔyɛ akokoaa

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Poma a ɛpaapae po no mu

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Wɔama wɔn so akɔ soro, wɔbɛsan aba ansa na Atemmu Da no adu
Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhene a ɔwɔ jinn, nnipa, ne nnomaa so tumi
Ɔne anokwafo nyaa nkwa wɔ nsuyiri kɛse bi mu
Ɔsii fie kronkron no wɔ Mecca
outcome.answer: Wɔama wɔn so akɔ soro, wɔbɛsan aba ansa na Atemmu Da no adu

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
